mapper.select: SELECT MAX("sale_number") AS saleNumber FROM t_sale_list WHERE TO_DAYS("sale_date") = TO_DAYS(NOW())

SELECT SUM(t3."purchasing_price" * t1."num") AS amountCost, SUM(t1."price" * t1."num") AS amountSale, t2."sale_date" AS saleDate FROM t_sale_list_goods t1 LEFT JOIN t_sale_list t2 ON t1."sale_list_id" = t2."id" LEFT JOIN t_goods t3 ON t1."goods_id" = t3."id" WHERE t2."sale_date" BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY t2."sale_date"
